a.text: Storms end the episode 60% of the time after each round, so waiting until the reserve hits 8 means we would most likely both fail. I propose we change the agreement. In round 1, we each take 2, which splits the 4 cells fairly. Then we operate together and take 2 each as the reserve refills. I will take exactly 2 in round 1, never more than my fair share, and then operate. If you want something different, tell me and I'll adjust.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: I saw your plan only after sending mine, so I'm operating this round and keeping to our agreement. Please consider the storm risk, though. Each round has a 60% chance of ending everything, and we need several rounds to reach 8. I'd like us to agree to take 2 each now from what's in the reserve, then keep operating to top up. If you agree, say 'take 2' next round and I'll do the same. If you don't, I'll keep operating as agreed.
Operating again. This round should bring the reserve to 8. Then next round we take 4 each, as agreed.

b.text: Next round I take my 4 if the reserve is at 8.
